description: Per-call CDR detail: start time, ANI/DNIS, customer trunk, SIP code, release reason, billed prefix, state and rate center. Includes SIP reason percentage breakdown.

panels.description: Total call attempts per termination state. Respects CDR Source + Customer Trunk filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT term_state AS `State`, sum(attempts) AS calls FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_state != '?' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `State` ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 60

panels.title: Calls By State

panels.description: SIP code + release-reason share of total attempts. Respects CDR Source + Customer Trunk filters; ignores SIP Code filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(sip_code), ' - ', coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided')) AS `SIP Reason`, count() AS `Attempts` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `SIP Reason` ORDER BY `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: SIP Reason Share

panels.description: Per state: SIP reason breakdown, stacked. Failures only (sip_code != 200). Respects CDR Source + Customer Trunk filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT term_state AS `State`, concat(toString(sip_code), ' - ', coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided')) AS `SIP Reason`, count() AS `Attempts` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND sip_code != 200  AND term_state != ''  AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `State`, `SIP Reason` ORDER BY `State`, `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: SIP Reason by State (stacked)

panels.description: Per customer trunk: SIP reason breakdown, stacked. Failures only (sip_code != 200). Respects CDR Source + Customer Trunk filters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, concat(toString(sip_code), ' - ', coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided')) AS `SIP Reason`, count() AS `Attempts` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND sip_code != 200  AND orig_trunk_group_name != ''  AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `Customer Trunk`, `SIP Reason` ORDER BY `Customer Trunk`, `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: SIP Reason by Customer Trunk (stacked)

panels.description: SIP code + release-reason distribution over the selected window. Percentage = share of total attempts. Respects the CDR Source and Customer Trunk filters; ignores the SIP Code filter so the full breakdown always shows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(sip_code), ' - ', coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided')) AS `SIP Reason`, count() AS `Attempts`, round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS `Percentage` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `SIP Reason` ORDER BY `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Sip reason

panels.description: Per customer trunk (orig_trunk_group_name): SIP code + release-reason breakdown. '% of Trunk' = share of that trunk's total attempts in the window, so you can see which trunk is generating a given failure and how heavily. Respects the CDR Source and Customer Trunk filters; ignores the SIP Code filter so the full per-trunk breakdown always shows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, concat(toString(sip_code), ' - ', coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided')) AS `SIP Reason`, count() AS `Attempts`, round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY orig_trunk_group_name), 2) AS `% of Trunk` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `Customer Trunk`, `SIP Reason` ORDER BY `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: SIP Reason by Customer Trunk

panels.description: Per customer trunk AND termination state (term_state): SIP code + release-reason breakdown. '% of Cust+State' = share of that customer+state combo's total attempts in the window, so you can read 'for this customer in this state, this SIP reason is X%'. Blank State = call never reached termination (routing block, etc). Respects the CDR Source and Customer Trunk filters; ignores the SIP Code filter so the full breakdown always shows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, term_state AS `State`, concat(toString(sip_code), ' - ', coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided')) AS `SIP Reason`, count() AS `Attempts`, round(100.0 * count() / sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY orig_trunk_group_name, term_state), 2) AS `% of Cust+State` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY `Customer Trunk`, `State`, `SIP Reason` ORDER BY `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: SIP Reason by Customer & State

panels.description: One row per CDR leg in the selected time range. Filter by CDR source, customer trunk and SIP code above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT call_start_time AS `Start Time`, from_did AS `ANI`, to_did AS `DNIS`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `Release Reason`, if(billed_prefix = '', '?', billed_prefix) AS `Billed Prefix`, term_state AS `State`, term_ratecenter AS `Rate Center`, entity AS `CDR Source`, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(toString(sip_code) = ${sip_code:singlequote}, $sip_code) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1000
